Subject: Priority reservation and custom overage terms request for Helios AI

Hi Jackson —

Thanks again for the time yesterday. Helios' timeline for product launch in Q4 means they need predictable Dedicated capacity during onboarding. Summary of their ask: 

- Dedicated cluster with H100s (16x H100s logical capacity) reserved for 12 months, start date targeted for 2026-09-01.
- Temporary reservation hold (30–60 days) while procurement completes — Helios asks that we not release the capacity during that hold.
- Burst capacity: ability to double throughput for the first 4 weeks of ramp (2x burst) with guaranteed availability.
- Non-standard overage terms: capped overage rate and a blended overage discount (they're asking for a floor at 85% of our published overage price).
- Commercial ask: 20% off committed monthly list for first 6 months as a ramp incentive; finance wants payment milestones aligned to delivery.

I've attached the latest SOW and their usage forecast. Jackson — can you confirm the procurement timeline and whether Helios is willing to accept a deferrable reservation fee?

This will need deal desk / exec review for the H100 requirement and the non-standard overage/hold terms. If you can confirm the latest forecast and any legal constraints, I can route for approval.

Next steps I propose:
1) I escalate to deal desk + Lauren for pricing exception + reservation hold authority.
2) Ask Legal to prepare a tailored SLA and reservation hold clause.
3) Finance to pre-check invoice schedule for deferred reservation fees.

Appreciate a quick confirmation so we can keep the slot.

Thanks,
Naomi Feldman

Thanks, received. Procurement is aiming to finish PO & legal review by 2026-08-25 but we can likely sign sooner if terms are clear. A few clarifications from our side:

- We need hard assurance the H100 capacity will be available for the start date (can't accept an automatic downgrade to A100).
- Reservation hold: 45 days is ideal for us. We can pay 25% of the first-month charge as a non-refundable hold fee if that makes it simpler.

Subject: Exec approval request — Helios AI priority reservation + tailored overage (RDW-DEAL-7831)

Team —

Escalating for quick exec signoff and guidance on terms. Background: Helios AI (large LLM customer) is requesting a Dedicated H100 reservation (12-month term) with a 45-day reservation hold, 2x burst for 28 days at guaranteed availability, and a non-standard overage cap. They are also asking for a 20% ramp discount for the first 6 months.

Key commercial asks and suggested internal position:
- GPU type: H100 required. Our standard replacement policy is A100 fallback; customer will not accept A100. Impact: H100 capacity on certain clusters is constrained in our us-west region for late-Aug start.
- Reservation hold: Customer proposes a 25% non-refundable hold fee. Suggested approach: accept a 30–45 day hold if finance can accept deferred recognition and we reserve the inventory.
- Burst/overage: Customer asks capped overage at 110% of list (10% premium). Suggested approval: allow capped overage at 110% of list for the first 60 days post-start, then revert to standard published overage. This preserves protection if they burst longer than expected.
- Discount: Approve up to 20% off committed monthly for first 6 months as onboarding incentive, subject to minimum committed spend (e.g., 60% of forecasted units).

Commercial rationale: This is a strategic early customer for our private LLM deployments and will be a public reference; downside is limited capacity and potential short-term revenue deferral. Legal needs to include a reservation-hold clause (non-refundable hold fee, inventory lock) and SLA addendum for burst availability.

I am requesting the following approvals:
1) Lauren — signoff on the 20% promotional discount and reservation hold policy (inventory commit).
2) Marcus — finance confirmation on deferred reservation fee accounting and proposed invoice milestones.
3) Marissa — ops confirmation that H100 capacity can be reserved and that burst can be guaranteed for 28 days with the requested concurrency.

If you approve, I'll have Legal craft the exact language and Finance produce the invoice schedule. Customer is asking for a decision today to keep the booked capacity.

Quoted earlier thread below for context.

Thanks,
Naomi

APPROVED (conditional) —

Thank you for the clear summary, Naomi. Given the strategic value and speed requirement, I approve the following concessions with the listed guardrails:

1) GPU type: Approve H100 reservation for the 12-month term. Ops to lock capacity in us-west and confirm back to Naomi by EOD. If H100 supply changes prior to the start date, Ops must notify both the customer and Sales immediately with alternatives.

2) Reservation hold: Approve a 45-day reservation hold. Accept the customer's proposal of a 25% non-refundable hold fee; Finance to accept deferred recognition and confirm accounting treatment.

3) Burst & overage: Approve 2x burst for 28 days. Approve capped overage at 110% of list (10% premium) for the first 60 days after the start date. After 60 days, revert to standard overage pricing. Ops to document concurrency limits and any technical constraints in the SOW.

4) Discount: Approve up to 20% off committed monthly for first 6 months, subject to a minimum committed utilization threshold equal to 60% of the forecasted units. If utilization falls below the threshold in month 6, Finance should apply a revenue true-up per the SOW.

5) Legal/Finance conditions: Legal to draft SLA addendum and reservation-hold clause; Finance to provide invoice milestones and confirm whether the reservation fee can be deferred to the first invoice. No final signature until Legal & Finance sign off on language.

Naomi — please proceed to instruct Legal & Finance to produce the final documents. Ops/Marissa/Marcus: confirm capacity and billing items back to the thread. Naomi: once we have final SOW, I will sign if the doc matches the approved terms.
